criteria.description: Validate shipped static GLB, official format validation, scale/origin, exact geometry/texture budgets and provenance.

Inspect all final exact views. Every concept panel inspected. Keep connected curved pearl chain but reduce giant ball height and overly noisy rock texture. Actual reference is shallow relief; design will be a single continuous raised rock surface with narrow necks, no detached components or copied specimen cracks.

One gently sinuous unbranched continuous chain of thirteen rounded subspherical sediment chambers joined by distinctly narrower necks. Raised fossil relief fused into a full-volume irregular quiet sediment slab, with chamber-to-neck breadth ratio at least2.4. Chambers are low rounded lobes, not detached beads, hearts, segmentation of an animal, or a reconstructed tracemaker. Stylized trace-morphology form concept. PRI76855 supports string-of-pearls relief from Devonian Ludlowville Formation, Tompkins County; period refers to that specimen only. Cambridge primary paper explains subspherical nodes and unresolved Hormosiroidea/Halimedides relationship. This is not a settled ichnotaxon or producer species. Relief polarity, behavior and maker uncertain. Scale, count and original S-path artistic; displayed exposed top is illustrative, not exact specimen reproduction.
